puzzles.name: Main Lobby Spider Web
puzzles.description: Burn the giant spider web blocking the main path using a Deku Stick lit from the nearby torch.
steps: Light Deku Stick at nearby torch
Run to spider web before stick burns out
hints: Torch particle effect points toward web

puzzles.name: Compass Room Puzzle
puzzles.description: Hit the crystal switch with the slingshot to lower the platform and access the compass chest.
steps: Shoot switch - turns from blue to orange

puzzles.name: Basement Spider Web
puzzles.description: Burn the web covering the door to the Queen Gohma arena. Must carry lit Deku Stick through water.
steps: Light Deku Stick at torch in previous room
Quickly run through shallow water (stick won't extinguish in shallow water)

puzzles.name: Queen Gohma Eye Weak Point
puzzles.description: Shoot Gohma's eye with slingshot when it turns red to stun her, then attack with sword.
steps: Wait for Gohma to climb ceiling
Watch for eye to turn red
hints: Eye glows bright red when vulnerable

puzzles.name: Hidden Grotto Behind Web
puzzles.description: Optional: Burn web in side room to find Gold Skulltula and recovery hearts.

phases.name: Ceiling Crawler
phases.mechanic: Gohma crawls on ceiling, drops eggs that hatch into Baby Gohma
phases.puzzle: Shoot red eye with slingshot when exposed

phases.name: Ground Charge
phases.mechanic: Gohma charges across floor, eye protected
phases.puzzle: Dodge charge, wait for eye to open after crash
phases.vulnerability: Eye opens briefly after wall crash

phases.name: Egg Laying Frenzy
phases.mechanic: Lays multiple eggs rapidly, Baby Gohma swarm
phases.puzzle: Clear babies, shoot eye during lay animation
phases.vulnerability: Eye stays red longer during egg laying
